reviews.review_title: Review at Ngoc Suong Ben Thuyen Restaurant
reviews.review_text:
Sondre H
Oslo, Norway1 contribution
0
Good food, but everything else...
Jun 2019 • Couples
We came and expected good food and service, but left unsatisfied. 

We got a table and menues, the waitor did not know any English but got a colleague to help him. We ordered 2 steaks, 2 mixed vegetables, 1 frenchfries, 2 beers and 1 Pepsi. 
The colleague also read the order up to confirm. We got 1 beer and one Pepsi. I then told him we ordered 2 beers, and if we could have one more.. he then gave me 2 ice cubes and ran away. 
I was a bit baffled,but it’s not a big deal. 

First we got 1 mixed vegetables after 20 min, then we got our beef 40 min later.. we should have specified that we wanted it all TOGEATHER. But we thought that was our mistake. Fair enough..

I tried to get a waiter to our table, but they would not even look our way, even though we were seated in the middle of the room. I got a bit tired of waiting so I reached an arm out, just to specify that I wanted something.. they ignored me for a good time.. when my (white) boyfriend just looked at a guy he ran to our table and asked him what he wanted.. I tried to do this again.. but they only addressed him.. I actually got quite angry. This has never happened before.. it was so disrespectful! 

We asked about the French fries, the other mixed vegetables and drink orders several times, but no one understood.. not even google translate could help us. 

We were so hungry that we just ate the beef all by its self.. the vegetables was eaten because we were sooo hungry, and we waited a looong time for the beef. 
When the colleague that speaks English came back, we asked him the same questions, he told us he could go check after them.. I got a bit cross because he blamed it on us.. but we confirmed the order and it was all correct.. it does not take 45 min to make fries.. 

Just say it’s a mistake and life goes on.. no biggie. Don’t start to point fingers.. especially at the guests who are a bit hangry.

Written June 12, 2019

A disappointment
Jun 2019 • Couples
Me and my partner wanted to have a nicer dinner and chose this place. They had an English menu, but it turned out that none of the waiters spoke English. I don’t blame them for that. After some tries with google translate the waiters brought the manager to help get the order. 

At this point we thought everything was in order, but no. The manager took the order, two beef, two fried vegetables, French fries, one Pepsi and two beer. First we got one beer and one Pepsi and asked for another beer which never came. After 20 minutes one of the vegetables came. After about one hour the two beef came, but not the other fried vegetables nor the fries. In addition I felt like the waiters ignored my partner and only addressed me..

We left rather disappointed and still hungry..
